title: A resumed flow run writes as its trigger user (the submitter), not the approver who resumed it, so post-decision writes in an approval flow name the submitter as Last Modified By and in the audit log
body:
Ruled: 6267719791 · letters Q1 A · Q2 A (ruling A item 2 re-read) · 2026-10-19T12:56Z

Ruled: 6257886738 · letter A · 2026-10-19T01:45Z

Filing gate **①**: a measured wrong attribution at a public door, with a named consumer. **`reach:`** `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID/approve` (and `/reject`) on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.3, with a sales rep as submitter and a sales manager as decider. Measured by the objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2061 item 2 dev (report comment 6249641221 on that card; PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2156). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`os-project-manager`, `session_01BDgipbNowaGa139em8Fhoq`). ⛔ Not a claim. **Grade and lane:** triage's. This may be a design question (see the last section); triage decides whether it needs a ruling.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack triage seat routes it. No HotCRM card waits on it: HotCRM ⛔ does not work around it (its AGENTS.md §2).

## What happens

An approval flow suspends at its approval node. The approver's decision resumes the run, and the nodes after the decision write as the run's **trigger user**, the submitter, not as the decider:
- `plugin-approvals` writes the verdict through `approvalStatusField` as the decider. That part is right.
- A later `update_record` in the same run writes a value only it owns, as the submitter. objectql's `sys_stamp_audit_update` then sets `updated_by` to the submitter, and `sys_audit_log` attributes the field change to the submitter, who never wrote it.

Measured in HotCRM on next.3, on four branches whose post-decision node writes a value of its own:
- `opportunity_approval` approve writes `approved_date`.
- `opportunity_status_change_approval` approve writes `stage` and `approved_date`, and reject writes `requested_status`.
- `opportunity_qualification_approval` reject writes `qualification_requested`.

On each of them, **Last Modified By** names the submitter after the manager decides. PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2156 removed the post-decision nodes that only restated the mirrored verdict, which fixed six other branches. These four cannot be fixed that way, because their writes are the point.

## Prior word

objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722's triage, as recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2061: "Whether a resumed run should attribute its writes to the decider is a platform design question. It is not filed, because no named need beyond this redundant node exists." These four HotCRM branches are that named need.

## Expected (to be decided by the platform)

Writes a resumed approval run makes after the decision are attributed to the decider, or the platform says which identity they carry and why. Either way, the record's `updated_by` and the audit trail should not name someone who did not act.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack, "resumed flow run writes attributed to trigger user not approver decider updated_by after approval": 25 hits, none open on this. The nearest are #3712 (a schedule-triggered run's context, closed), #4466 (an admin override's marker, closed) and #15389 (restored suspensions, closed).
